hypotheses.justification: The proof never names `hu`: a search of the file finds it only on its binder line (60). The proof uses only intro, obtain, choose, rw, simp only ... at h2, refine, exact, show and rfl. None of these picks up hypotheses from the context implicitly (no assumption, simp_all, aesop or simp [*]). The facts the proof does use about u are hεu, hwuε and huεw at level 1, and hFV. So the same proof should compile with `hu` deleted, and the statement stays true.

The proof never names `hwtr`: it appears only on its binder line (64). The proof uses w only through hεw, hwε, hwuε and huεw at level 1, passed to exists_cartierDualMap_id_eq_frobenius_conv_verschiebung_of_comp_eq_idempotent_of_cartierDualMap_pow_eq. No tactic in the proof can use context hypotheses implicitly. So the same proof should work with `hwtr` deleted. It can be deleted independently of `hu`, or together with it.
